sample_unit: questions (FAQs) about robot-assisted total hip arthroplasty

links.outcome: Type and academic quality of sources cited by ChatGPT-4o versus Google
links.effect: ChatGPT cited significantly more academic references than Google (70% vs. 20%, p=0.0113); Google cited more medical practice references (40% vs. 0%, p=0.0033).
links.quote: The ChatGPT provided significantly more academic references than Google search (70% vs. 20%, p=0.0113).

links.outcome: Clinician-graded quality of ChatGPT-4o answers to patient FAQs about RATHA
links.effect: 62% of answers rated Grade 1-2 (excellent or satisfactory with minimal clarification); 38% required moderate or substantial clarification (Grades 3-4).
links.quote: In terms of response quality, 62% of answers were rated as Grade 1-2 (excellent or satisfactory with minimal clarification), while 38% required moderate or substantial clarification (Grades 3-4).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates ChatGPT-4o's performance in answering patient FAQs about robot-assisted total hip arthroplasty compared to Google search results, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
